card.name: Assorted words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted words such as 'e' in e.g., 'Hydro', 'Package', 'the', 'your', 'We' in usage directions and drug text.
card.plain: It fires on unrelated words in dosing and usage instructions, with no pattern that can be stated.
